## RFC

- RFC path:
- Branch: `rfc/<slug>`
- PR title: `RFC: <Title>`
- Review status:
- Design review:
- Comments until:
- Review until:
- Required approvers:

## Checklist

- [ ] RFC lives under `rfcs/<year>/<slug>/rfc.md`
- [ ] Branch is named `rfc/<slug>`
- [ ] PR title starts with `RFC: `
- [ ] Frontmatter is filled with the minimum fields
- [ ] PR is Draft while `review_status: draft`
- [ ] `comments_until` is set before `review_status: accepting_comments`
- [ ] `review_until` and `required_approvers` are set before `review_status: in_review`
- [ ] Required approvers approve through GitHub Review
- [ ] Images are pasted through GitHub or stored under optional `assets/`

## Discussion

Use PR comments and inline review comments for RFC feedback.
